Reproducer: https://godbolt.org/z/PaGjcrMTa
Testcase:
```llvm
target datalayout = "e-m:e-p:64:64-p1:64:64-p2:32:32-p3:32:32-p4:64:64-p5:32:32-p6:32:32-p7:160:256:256:32-p8:128:128:128:48-p9:192:256:256:32-i64:64-v16:16-v24:32-v32:32-v48:64-v96:128-v192:256-v256:256-v512:512-v1024:1024-v2048:2048-n32:64-S32-A5-G1-ni:7:8:9"
target triple = "amdgcn-amd-amdhsa"

define void @func_33() {
entry:
  br label %BS_LABEL_0

BS_LABEL_0:                                       ; preds = %BS_LABEL_0, %entry
  callbr void asm sideeffect "", "!i,!i"()
          to label %BS_LABEL_4 [label %BS_LABEL_0, label %BS_LABEL_4]

BS_LABEL_4:                                       ; preds = %BS_LABEL_0, %BS_LABEL_0
  ret void
}
```

comments.author: ro-i
comments.body: Thanks for reporting! Seems like there is an issue with duplicate target blocks, as in your example `%BS_LABEL_4 [label %BS_LABEL_0, label %BS_LABEL_4]`

issue.title: [AMDGPU][UnifyLoopExits] Assertion `!IsSuccessor(To, From) && "Deleted edge still exists in the CFG!"' failed.

tests.test_body:
define void @callbr_duplicate_successors() {
entry:
  br label %loop

loop:                                             ; preds = %loop, %entry
  callbr void asm sideeffect "", "!i,!i"()
          to label %exit [label %loop, label %exit]

exit:                                             ; preds = %loop, %loop
  ret void
}

define void @loop_1_callbr(i1 %PredEntry, i1 %PredB, i1 %PredC, i1 %PredD) {
entry:
  br i1 %PredEntry, label %A, label %G

A:                                                ; preds = %D, %entry
  br label %B

B:                                                ; preds = %A
  callbr void asm "", "r,!i"(i1 %PredB)
          to label %C [label %E]

C:                                                ; preds = %B
  callbr void asm "", "r,!i"(i1 %PredC)
          to label %D [label %F]

D:                                                ; preds = %C
  callbr void asm "", "r,!i"(i1 %PredD)
          to label %A [label %F]

E:                                                ; preds = %B
  br label %exit

F:                                                ; preds = %G, %D, %C
  br label %exit

G:                                                ; preds = %entry
  br label %F

exit:                                             ; preds = %F, %E
  ret void
}

define void @loop_2_callbr(i1 %PredA, i1 %PredB, i1 %PredC) {
entry:
  br label %A

A:                                                ; preds = %D, %entry
  callbr void asm "", "r,!i"(i1 %PredA)
          to label %B [label %X]

B:                                                ; preds = %A
  callbr void asm "", "r,!i"(i1 %PredB)
          to label %C [label %Y]

C:                                                ; preds = %B
  callbr void asm "", "r,!i"(i1 %PredC)
          to label %D [label %Z]

D:                                                ; preds = %C
  br label %A

X:                                                ; preds = %A
  br label %exit

Y:                                                ; preds = %B
  br label %exit

Z:                                                ; preds = %C
  br label %exit

exit:                                             ; preds = %Z, %Y, %X
  ret void
}
